verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI platform like Mistral, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a recurring schedule, cron, or timed trigger. Batch processing is a one-off asynchronous job, not a recurring schedule. Agent handoffs automate delegation between agents but include no scheduling, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
